question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Rahul had __strong__ pain in his stomach.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **severe**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"strong"** means having great physical power and ability; it can also describe something intense or forceful. (मजबूत)

 
 
• **Example:** He has a strong grip, which makes him a good wrestler.
 
 
 
• **"Severe"** refers to something very intense or serious, often used to describe pain or weather conditions. (तीव्र)
 
 
• **Example:** She was rushed to the hospital due to severe chest pain.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to replace "strong" in the context of pain is "severe".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **severe**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strict** (सख्त): Demanding that rules concerning behavior are obeyed and observed.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher is very strict about homework deadlines.
 
 
 
• **Deep** (गहरा): Extending far down from the top or surface.
 
 
• **Example:** The lake is very deep in the middle.
 
 
 
• **High** (ऊँचा): Of great vertical extent.
 
 
• **Example:** The mountain is very high.
